meta.source: nflverse play by play, 1999 to 2026, regular season and postseason combined

season2026.caveat: 2026 ratings cover Weeks 1 to 10. Week 10 is partial: 13 of 14 games are scored. All scored games have play by play data. Not in this data: LAC at BAL (2026-11-16). Teams with a Week 10 bye: CHI, DEN, PHI, TB. Data pulled on November 16, 2026.

meta.scale: Each component score is 100 + 15 * (value - pool mean) / pool spread; inverted components use 100 - 15 * the same ratio. Rating is the weighted mean of component scores. 100 is the average qualifier.
meta.receiver_id_repair: In 2003 to 2008, receiver_player_id is missing on incomplete passes; the receiver key is receiver_player_id filled from receiver_id where missing. The two fields agree wherever both are present.

2026.threshold: at least 100 touches and 50 rush attempts

career.threshold: at least 500 touches and 250 rush attempts
